title: code.verify-resolutions input
description: The orchestrated step envelope as code.verify-resolutions sees it. This is a self-round target: `code.orchestrate-review` rebinds its own session for one turn, so the envelope is the controller's, with `boundAction` set. `artifacts.postedReview` is the comment set to verify — one line per comment.

artifacts.description: `postedReview` is what code.post-pr-review actually posted; `resolutions` is an earlier pass's verdicts, to be carried forward.

boundAction.description: Set to this action on the turn it runs.

boundNote.description: Optional narrowing: which comments the controller wants re-checked this round.

pr.description: Live PR facts kept by the watcher. The author's replies live here — context only; the verdict comes from the diff.
